trends.name: Frontier cyber capabilities trigger release and governance thresholds
trends.summary: OpenAI says its models may reach critical cyber capabilities, while strengthening oversight, monitoring and release pacing.
trends.attention_driver: The risks of highly autonomous cyber tasks have moved from a model evaluation issue to a product release constraint.

evidence.quote: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models.
evidence.claim: This supports that OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment and safety measures for frontier models.

evidence.quote: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security
evidence.claim: This supports that governance and national security oversight are being included in discussions of AI deployment.

evidence.quote: its upcoming Astra model may have reached “critical” cyber capabilities
evidence.claim: This provides external reporting that model cyber capabilities have reached a critical threshold.

trends.so_what: If a product can execute code, browse or operate systems, add permission tiers, human confirmation and auditable kill switches by task risk within two weeks. Build safety thresholds into the release process, or capability iteration will directly slow commercial delivery.

trends.name: Agent platforms productize computer operation and skill assets
trends.summary: Anthropic has made computer operation, browser tools, Skills API and file capabilities fully available, while Qwen has also released a GUI agent for multiple endpoints.
trends.attention_driver: Task execution capabilities are entering mainstream platforms as callable skills and real interface operations.

evidence.quote: Anthropic 宣布 Computer Use、Skills API 与 Files API 在 Claude Platform 全面可用，并新增浏览器操作工具
evidence.claim: This supports that Claude Platform has made computer operation, skills and file capabilities generally available.

evidence.quote: 阿里巴巴正式推出 Qwen-UI-Agent，一个以真实世界为中心的 GUI 智能体基座模型
evidence.claim: This supports that multi-endpoint GUI operation is becoming a direction of competition for agent products.

trends.so_what: Product differentiation will depend more on task packaging, permission controls and result verification than on chat interfaces. Prioritize breaking high-frequency workflows into versionable skills, and set recoverable checkpoints for browser operations.

trends.name: AI feeds add explicit preferences and source controls
trends.summary: Google plans to let users adjust their Discover feed in natural language, and provide publishers with a preferred source button across Search and Discover.
trends.attention_driver: Conversational personalization and content source selection are being added to information distribution products at the same time.

evidence.quote: customize your Discover feed by describing what you want to see
evidence.claim: This supports that Google will configure the Discover feed through natural language.

evidence.quote: make them a preferred source across Search, Discover, and Google
evidence.claim: This supports that Google is providing an explicit cross-product preference entry point for content sources.

trends.so_what: Treat preference explanations, undo functions and source controls as core experiences rather than settings-page extras. Products that depend on discovery traffic should begin measuring the differences between being cited, recommended and set as a user preference.

watch_list.name: GLM-5.3 strengthens open model competition with low-cost flagship positioning
watch_list.summary: The GLM-5.3 API has launched and claims a score of 60 on the AA Comprehensive Intelligence Index. Market discussion focuses on its complex coding, long-horizon tasks and lower cost.
watch_list.attention_driver: Open-weight and API models are competing simultaneously on capability, price and inference supply.

evidence.quote: GLM-5.3 API即日上线，擅长复杂编码、防御性网络安全与长程任务
evidence.claim: This supports that the GLM-5.3 API has been released and emphasizes complex task capabilities.

evidence.quote: 想提前锁定智谱推理算力的客户也不少
evidence.claim: This supports rising market attention to inference supply and API access after the release.

evidence.quote: GLM 5.3 and the new Post-training Scaling Law
evidence.claim: This supports that GLM 5.3 has entered model competition narratives in independent industry discussion.

watch_list.so_what: Turn new model integration into reversible routing and task evaluation rather than a one-time supplier replacement. Compare success rate, latency and cost per task separately for coding and long-horizon tasks.

insights.text: Agent releases must first pass risk gates: models that can operate real systems will have their release pace constrained by permissions, audits and human confirmation
Discovery traffic can be reconfigured by users: natural-language preferences and source selection will change distribution metrics for content products
The tool connection layer is expanding: gateway and WebMCP signals around Agent framework are increasing, so integration protocols need room for replacement
